description: Submit an online Hong Kong corporate bank account opening pre-screening application (Stage 1 KYC dossier) for HSBC Hong Kong (hsbc) or OCBC Bank Hong Kong (ocbc). REQUIRES USER LOGIN (personal API Key hkq_live_... obtained after signing in at https://www.86hc.com/user, passed via X-API-Key header or api_key parameter). Automatically resolves the company from 86hc.com's 3.9M+ registry, binds the BK-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX reference number to the user's account, notifies HC Business licensed TCSP (TC006431) compliance officers in real time, sends an official confirmation email, and returns a Stage 2 continuation URL where the logged-in user can upload statutory documents (CI, BRC, NNC1/NAR1, IDs) and complete Cap. 553 electronic signature.

agent_platform.description: Optional name of the calling AI platform (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Coze, Doubao, Baidu Wenxin).

api_key.description: Personal 86hc.com API Key (hkq_live_xxxx) obtained after signing in at https://www.86hc.com/user (required if X-API-Key header is not configured).

applicant_role.description: Role of the applicant in the Hong Kong company.

bank_target.description: Target bank: hsbc (HSBC Hong Kong), ocbc (OCBC Bank Hong Kong), or both.

contact_email.description: Applicant email address to receive the official application receipt and compliance review updates.

contact_name.description: Full name of the applicant / director / authorized handler.

contact_phone.description: Contact mobile phone number with country/region code (e.g. +86 13800138000 or +852 91234567).

contact_wechat.description: Optional WeChat ID or WhatsApp number for 1-on-1 compliance officer liaison.

directors_shareholders.description: Optional summary of directors and 25%+ Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO).

has_mainland_company.description: Whether there is an affiliated Mainland China operating company.

identifier.description: Hong Kong company name (Chinese or English), 7-digit CR number, or 8-digit BRN.

industry.description: Industry sector (e.g. EXPORT_TRADE, ECOMMERCE_2C, ECOMMERCE_2B, IT_SOFTWARE, CONSULTING_SVC, STARTUP_COMPANY, LOGISTICS_SUPPLY).

mainland_company_name.description: Optional name of the affiliated Mainland China company.

products_services.description: Specific goods traded or services rendered (e.g. Consumer electronics export, cross-border SaaS subscription).

signing_location.description: Preferred signing mode (e.g. 赴港分行现场面签 or 内地指定城市分行视频见证).

trading_countries.description: Major counterparty countries or regions (e.g. ["China", "Hong Kong", "Singapore", "USA"]).

user_note.description: Optional additional notes or questions from the applicant.

name: submit_bank_account_application
